use Mimikatz and NirSoft and Remote Desktop Passview to export browser client credentials
enumerate connected storage devices, running processes, and encrypt user files

install and use Mega.io to export victim files to cloud storage
archive data as .rar or .zip files for later exfiltration

encrypt all connected logical drives using Phobos.exe
display unique ransom note embedded in executable on infected workstations
